Job Description
 Why This Role Matters 
 Publicis Sapient is looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our team of bright thinkers and doers. You’ll use your problem-solving creativity to figure out our client’s most complex and challenging problems across different industries. You should be insightful, inquisitive, and naturally collaborative, with a strong desire to share ideas and opinions.
This role is an excellent opportunity for someone who would like to join an international global organization with a start-up mentality. We highly value Openness, Collaboration, Learning Mindset and partner with our clients to drive positive outcomes.
 Where You’ll Make an Impact 
Work with business stakeholders & functional teams, fulfilling their data needs and helping them to leverage analytics to improve their domains and act faster, and make better decisions
Assisting our clients in determining how to measure and analyze the effectiveness of their business
Consult clients to shape and define the role and success of analytics in their business
Design and develop reports/dashboards using various analytics and visualization tools
Continually optimizing existing reports/dashboards to improve performance benchmarking
Prepare and publish weekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad-hoc reports/dashboards
Engage with relevant stakeholders and provide analysis, reporting and presentations to effectively communicate on insights and KPIs
Identifies and resolves any data quality issues by conducting both routine and ad-hoc data cleaning and testing
Using various tools to identify, analyze, and interpret patterns and trends in complex data sets
Coaching and supporting key users to adopt the reporting tool.
 What You’ll Bring To The Team
Demonstrated ability to work closely with business partners, understand requirements, and provide accurate findings of analysis
Strong working knowledge of data visualization tools such as Power BI (preferably), Tableau or Qlik
Ability to analyze large datasets
Great analytical skills, self-driven and an eye for detail and quality
Solid SQL, Power (M) Query, DAX, Data Visualization
Experience with one or multiple cloud data stores - Databricks / Fabric / Snowflake / GCP / AWS and DWH concepts
Good stakeholder management skills
Good team and business communication skills, including presentation and facilitation skills, and strong attention to detail; can walk through approach with technical clients or explain tricky concepts to non-technical audiences
Experience with agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira or similar).
 Additional Experience We Value
R and/or Python experience
Google Analytics / Mipxanel / Amplitude / Adobe Analytics
A/B testing
Data Governance experience
Martech experience
Financial reporting
 Additional Information
 What You’ll Get in Return
A fast-paced tech environment
Continuous growth & learning
Open feedback culture
Room for own initiative & ideas
Transparency about results & strategy
Recognition & reward for hard work
Working with a flexible schedule 
Medical subscription
Meal tickets
Extra vacation days
Many other perks 
 Company Description
 About Publicis Sapient
 Most companies in the AI era do one of two things: they advise, or they sell you a tool. We do both. Publicis Sapient is a technology company that provides enterprise AI platforms and services, which means we build our own AI platforms and bring the strategists, product thinkers, designers and engineers who make them work inside the world s most complex businesses. It s where people and products shape the future of enterprise, and where your ideas actually reach the organizations that run the world. If you want to question how things are done, learn continuously and do the best work of your career alongside 20,000 people across 28 countries, you re in the right place. Come build with us.
 Our Commitment to Inclusive Hiring 
 We are committed to fostering and encouraging an inclusive and welcoming environment for everyone and we believe great talent comes from many different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. That s why we re committed to creating a hiring process where everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and feel safe. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and identities including: race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion and value the diverse experiences, perspectives, and strengths they bring to our teams.
If there s anything we can do to make our recruitment process more accessible or comfortable for you, please let us know. We re happy to provide reasonable adjustments throughout the application and interview process. You can contact us anytime at emeahiringteam@publicissapient.com.
 Your Safety Matters To Us
 At Publicis Sapient, we re committed to protecting candidates throughout every step of their journey with us. To help you stay safe from recruitment scams, please remember that our recruiters will only ever contact you from a Publicis Sapient email address. In some cases, we may partner with trusted, vetted recruitment agencies who will clearly identify themselves as working on behalf of Publicis Sapient. If you receive communication from any other domain claiming to represent us, please treat it with caution and contact us at emeahiringteam@publicissapient.com.
